description: Baseline linear combination of supervised XGBoost calibrated likelihood and unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly score, standardized to [0, 100].

xgb_score.name: XGBoost Supervised Likelihood
xgb_score.justification: Primary supervised classifier trained on ground-truth AML typologies (ROC-AUC 0.9166, Precision 97.09%, FPR 0.19%). An operational baseline weighting of 80% XGBoost and 20% Isolation Forest was selected because XGBoost demonstrated substantially stronger validated supervised precision and lower false-positive rate, while Isolation Forest provides complementary anomaly coverage including 135 AML-labeled cases missed by XGBoost at the standard threshold. The 80/20 weighting is NOT statistically optimized and is NOT derived directly from the precision ratio.

if_score.name: Isolation Forest Unsupervised Anomaly Score

normalization_anchors.boundary_0_50: Theoretical/implementation decision boundary from Liu et al. (2008) and scikit-learn (offset_ = -0.50) where path length equals average BST depth c(n).
normalization_anchors.anchor_0_35: Fixed operational normalization anchor representing the empirical floor of background inliers observed in the training distribution. NOT a theoretical constant; NOT tuned using 30k ground-truth labels.
normalization_anchors.anchor_0_70: Fixed operational normalization anchor representing the empirical ceiling of extreme multidimensional outliers in the training distribution. NOT a theoretical constant; NOT tuned using 30k ground-truth labels.

if_score.justification: Unsupervised structural anomaly detector (ROC-AUC 0.7282, captures 135 true AML cases missed by XGBoost). Carries 20% baseline weight to provide anomaly boosting and zero-day defense without overwhelming alert queues.

graph_score.name: Standalone Graph Risk Score
graph_score.justification: Assigned weight 0.00 to prevent double counting. All 22 Phase 3 graph features (PageRank, degrees, cycles) are already natively ingested by XGBoost and Isolation Forest.

rule_score.name: Standalone Rule Engine Risk Score
rule_score.justification: Assigned weight 0.00 to prevent double counting and arbitrary heuristics. All rule proxies (threshold proximity, velocity spikes, multi-accounting) are already engineered features in the ML models.

compliance_disclaimer: The scoring system prioritizes transactions for investigation; it does NOT autonomously determine that a SAR must be filed. Final SAR filing and compliance disposition remain subject to appropriate investigator/compliance review.

evaluation_summary.note: The 30,000 out-of-time labels were used only for retrospective validation after the scoring design was fixed. Prevalences reflect historical evaluation sample results, not guaranteed future probabilities.
